title: Image-size notice on the Claude screen restates IMAGE_LIMIT by hand
notes: src/chat-view.ts:381 says 'over 5 MB of images' while the limit lives in IMAGE_LIMIT (src/chat-transcript.ts:32). That is a second copy of the refusal's condition, which CLAUDE.md's refusal rule forbids. Cost: change IMAGE_LIMIT and the notice keeps telling users the old cap. Fix: export a shown form of the limit from chat-transcript.ts and build the message from it. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/89  Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/87#discussion_r4419421816

comments.body: Shipped in PR #143: the image-size notice on the Claude screen is built from IMAGE_LIMIT instead of restating 5 MB by hand.
